title: url.parse is deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates url.parse() because its behavior is not standardized and error-prone with security implications (DEP0169): documentation-only since v19.0.0 and v18.13.0, application runtime warning since v24.0.0.
replacement: The WHATWG URL API, new URL()

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace url.parse
steps.instructions: Parse with new URL(input, base) and read its properties instead of the legacy url object; review inputs that are not absolute URLs.
